title: Adaptive Bregman Proximal Stochastic Gradient with a Stabilized Barzilai--Borwein Step Size
abstract: arXiv:2608.12009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bregman proximal stochastic gradient (BPSG) methods bring variance-reduced composite optimization to objectives whose geometry is poorly captured by Euclidean smoothness. Their performance, however, remains sensitive to the step size: raw stochastic curvature estimates can fluctuate sharply, whereas line searches add repeated proximal evaluations. We introduce Ada-BPSG, a line-search-free BPSG method that couples the SAGA gradient table with a stabilized Barzilai--Borwein (BB) candidate. A mediant aggregates incremental secant information so that nearly singular local ratios receive little weight, and an explicit safeguard translates the resulting curvature estimate into the bounded step-size sequence required for convergence. This design yields a direct analytical chain from relative smoothness and component-wise variance control to convergence in finite-dimensional normed spaces. We prove an $O(n/K)$ ergodic rate for convex objective

translated_title: 自适应Bregman近端随机梯度法及稳定化Barzilai-Borwein步长
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12009v1 公告类型：跨领域 摘要：Bregman近端随机梯度（BPSG）方法将方差缩减的复合优化扩展到目标函数的几何特性无法被欧几里得光滑性充分捕捉的场景。然而，其性能对步长仍然敏感：原始随机曲率估计可能剧烈波动，而线搜索则增加了重复的近端评估。我们引入了Ada-BPSG，一种无需线搜索的BPSG方法，它将SAGA梯度表与稳定化的Barzilai-Borwein（BB）候选步长相结合。一种中位数聚合器整合增量割线信息，使得近乎奇异的局部比率获得较小权重，同时一个显式的保护机制将由此得到的曲率估计转化为有界步长序列，以满足收敛性要求。这一设计建立了一条从相对光滑性和分量方差控制到有限维赋范空间中收敛性的直接解析链条。我们证明了凸目标下的$O(n/K)$遍历收敛率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需线搜索的自适应Bregman近端随机梯度方法，通过稳定化Barzilai-Borwein步长和SAGA梯度表，实现了凸优化下的$O(n/K)$收敛率，并有效处理了曲率估计的波动问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a line-search-free adaptive Bregman proximal stochastic gradient method with a stabilized Barzilai-Borwein step size and SAGA gradient table, achieving an $O(n/K)$ ergodic convergence rate for convex objectives while handling curvature estimate fluctuations.
